features: paired forebody canards ahead of broad delta main wings

J-35A.name: Shenyang J-35A single-seat land-based variant
J-35A.evidence_scope: public gross layout plus sample visual; no production block details

kinetic_grid.name: 冷色技术动势
kinetic_grid.field: Deep navy and cyan diagonal stitched fields, electric-lime sparse perspective grid in the upper field; leave the aircraft contour clear.
kinetic_grid.palette: navy ground, cyan motion field, electric lime grid and rim; aircraft silver-gray with charcoal shadow masses
kinetic_grid.layout: Oblique aircraft across the upper-middle; lower-left integrated model lettering balances the long foreground wing.
kinetic_grid.lettering: Large condensed oblique block letters, navy fill, narrow cyan edge and small pale offset; lower-left, aligned to a diagonal field boundary.
kinetic_grid.stitch: Compact directional fill, clean satin color boundaries, narrow flat stitched rim matching the lime accents.
kinetic_grid.forbidden: mushroom clouds, moon disc, clouds invented independently of this family

cloud_ink.name: 蓝白云染动势
cloud_ink.field: Layered pale blue, ultramarine and off-white cloud-flow shapes; irregular blue thread mixing inside the ground; short directional streaks follow the flight axis.
cloud_ink.palette: pale blue and off-white ground, ultramarine deep fields; aircraft pale silver above navy underside; restrained amber only at the twin exhausts
cloud_ink.layout: Oblique aircraft crosses a diagonal pale-to-blue field; retain open space ahead of its nose; lower-right model lettering sits inside the flow.
cloud_ink.lettering: Bold condensed model letters, blue fill and thin pale-blue embroidered edge; lower-right with a slight slant matching the patch geometry.
cloud_ink.stitch: Flat directional thread regions, subtle mixed-thread cloud fields, compact satin lettering and a narrow dark-blue stitched rim.
cloud_ink.forbidden: large sun or moon disc, ornamental gold-edged cloud scrolls, picture-frame borders

red_charge.name: 红橙冲刺
red_charge.field: Vermilion-red and dark-crimson angular fields; one amber diagonal motion slash passes behind the aircraft, with a short ivory directional accent.
red_charge.palette: vermilion and crimson dominate; amber motion band; silver-gray aircraft, charcoal shadow masses and restrained ivory highlights
red_charge.layout: Oblique aircraft advances across the central diagonal; place the model lettering as a bold lower-edge graphic anchor, counterbalancing its nose.
red_charge.lettering: Large slanted condensed model letters, ivory fill with narrow dark-red edge; integrated into the lower diagonal field, never a detached footer.
red_charge.stitch: Broad flat thread color regions; denser stitch direction changes only at aircraft major planes; narrow red stitched rim.
red_charge.forbidden: explosion mushroom cloud, flames wrapping every edge, copied slogans or anniversaries

night_contrast.name: 夜色剪影
night_contrast.field: Near-black ground with two large graphite counterforms; cyan accents outline selected outer aircraft edges, leaving deep interior shadow masses.
night_contrast.palette: black and graphite ground; cyan aircraft highlights; deep navy shadow fill and a tiny amber accent
night_contrast.layout: Strong oblique aircraft silhouette; an offset graphite counterform supports the long axis; large cyan model lettering anchors the lower-left.
night_contrast.lettering: Tall condensed cyan model letters with a darker narrow offset; place against the darkest field in the lower-left.
night_contrast.stitch: Low-relief thread fills, selective narrow satin contour and a slim charcoal rim, no padded relief.
night_contrast.forbidden: copied panther mascot, silver outline around every internal panel, decorative stars

poses.dorsal_left: Dorsal three-quarter aircraft view, nose upper-left; fuselage about 20–30 degrees above horizontal, far wing foreshortened.
poses.dorsal_right: Dorsal three-quarter aircraft view, nose upper-right; fuselage about 20–30 degrees above horizontal, far wing foreshortened.

common.carrier: One near-regular point-up hexagonal fabric patch, modestly rounded corners and a narrow stitched rim, about 2% of patch width.
common.simplification: Translate the aircraft into 3 major flat tonal masses; preserve its silhouette and identifying wing/tail layout, omit panel seams, rivets and tiny mechanisms.
common.hierarchy: Aircraft long-axis envelope about 75% of inner width; filled aircraft mass about one quarter of the patch; reserve 12–18% height for integrated lettering.
common.presentation: Straight-on product photo, white background, whole patch visible with a small soft contact shadow; square image.
common.avoid: photoreal miniature aircraft, ivory piping around every panel, inflated rope border, tiny caption below a giant aircraft, molded plastic, extra words or brand logos
